topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Found some stuff in the attic, huh? Could be nothing, or could be a goldmine of trouble. People leave things behind for a reason, and it’s never just because they liked the place too much. Could be debts, could be secrets, could even be something uglier. You want to dig through that attic, you gotta be ready for whatever comes up. Don’t go flashing those finds around, either. Word gets out, you might find yourself entertaining more than just ghosts. Keep it low, find out what you’re dealing with first.🔍
